result: Cubic-regularized Newton steps built from sampled gradients and Hessian-vector products reach ε-second-order stationary points in Õ(ε^{−3.5}) stochastic evaluations, faster than perturbed SGD's Õ(ε^{−4}).
result_plain: Stochastic cubic regularization: Õ(ε^−3.5) gradient + HVP evaluations to an ε-SOSP.
